; Plain-field selection over targets a dictionary does not map. PlainIntPolicy
; selects an int column; NoDictionaryPolicy declares no dictionary at all.
(: Repository
   (* (: url str)))

(: Blob
   (* (: repository Repository)
      (: ordinary str)
      (: size int)))

(: SharedTextDictionary (*))

(: BlobRoot
   (* (: capability "storage-root-v1")
      (: target Blob)))

(: TextDictionarySelection
   (* (: capability "scalar-dictionary-v1")
      (: scalar str)
      (: dictionary SharedTextDictionary)))

(: PlainSize
   (* (: capability "plain-field-v1")
      (: owner Blob)
      (: position 2)))

(: PlainText
   (* (: capability "plain-field-v1")
      (: owner Blob)
      (: position 1)))

(: PlainIntPolicy
   (* (: capability "interned-storage-policy-v1")
      (: root BlobRoot)
      (: dictionary TextDictionarySelection)
      (: storage_plain PlainSize)))

(: PlainTextPolicy
   (* (: capability "interned-storage-policy-v1")
      (: root BlobRoot)
      (: dictionary TextDictionarySelection)
      (: storage_plain PlainText)))

(: NoDictionaryPolicy
   (* (: capability "interned-storage-policy-v1")
      (: root BlobRoot)
      (: storage_plain PlainSize)))
